rationale: This corrective delta preserves the accepted product FSK capture behavior and fixes only its fixture-free Full/Guided smoke. Candidate 0.142 proved that an unattached antenna produces enough asynchronous GDO0 noise to overflow a 512-edge ring between main-loop passes. Plan-v10 now opens, drains and closes one bounded ISR window in the same service pass for each of 32 RSSI samples, matching the product rule that long-lived GDO0 capture is admitted only by a real RSSI carrier. Board profile, partitions, receive configuration, storage formats and all TX prohibitions remain unchanged.
required_host_checks: full host/source/docs suite in tracked-evidence mode
Full/Guided plan-v10 native result and both heap-floor negative cases
same-pass FSK ISR attach/sample/drain/detach and no-TX source contract
exact firmware build and resource budget
required_hil_scenarios: one public Full/Guided delta run through nRF24, CC1101 spectrum, OOK, FSK and IR receive smoke
32 bounded FSK ISR windows complete without overflow on the no-fixture board
Quick and final Full reports pass both explicit current-product heap gates
disposable scratch removed with product CID, generation and observations unchanged
zero radio TX commands, input drops and final ownership
